lore: The hellbender is a giant salamander of the clear, fast, rocky streams of the eastern United States, and at up to 74 cm the largest amphibian in North America. Flat-bodied and loose-skinned, it breathes almost entirely through the wrinkled folds along its sides, so it can only live in cold, well-oxygenated water. It spends the day wedged under a single flat rock and emerges at night to hunt crayfish. Its family has changed little in some 160 million years.
